title: Advanced Energy Showcases Power Delivery with Unmatched Control for Advanced IC Manufacturing at SEMICON West
summary: Advanced Energy will showcase plasma power, sensing, and control products designed to deliver the precision and performance demanded by the Angstrom-era and the latest advanced integrated circuit (IC) manufacturing techniques at SEMICON West 2026, from Oct. 13 to Oct. 15 in San Francisco.
body_markdown:
**Showcasing Power Control Solutions for Sub-2nm Etch and Deposition Profiles**


**DENVER — Oct. 9, 2026** —[Advanced Energy Industries Inc.](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/) (Nasdaq: AEIS) will showcase plasma power, sensing, and control products designed to deliver the precision and performance demanded by the Angstrom-era and the latest advanced integrated circuit (IC) manufacturing techniques at[SEMICON West 2026,](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/about/news/events/semicon-west-2026/) from Oct. 13 to Oct. 15 in San Francisco.


The company is a global leader in highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement, and control solutions. Highlighted technologies include the[eVerest® RF generator platform](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/plasma-power-products/rf-plasma-generators/everest/) , enabling process development and volume manufacturing for sub-2 nm deposition and etch processes. The[eVoS® ME bias](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/plasma-power-products/power-delivery-systems/evos-me-asymmetric-bias-waveform-generator/) supply enables the most advanced etch profiles for 3D chip structures through precise Ion energy control. At SEMICON West, Advanced Energy will unveil a new product designed to deliver more accurate, repeatable measurements, and deeper process insight.


“Advanced Energy develops high-precision power delivery systems that are based on modular architecture, which makes them highly configurable,” said Juergen Braun, Executive Vice President, Plasma Power, Advanced Energy. “As a result of our engineering work, we deliver tailored waveforms that ensure the most accurate power delivery and control.”


**Featured Solutions:**


- Plasma Power: eVerest generator,[NavX™](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/plasma-power-products/power-delivery-systems/rfds/) impedance matching network,[eVoS ME bias](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/plasma-power-products/power-delivery-systems/evos-me-asymmetric-bias-waveform-generator/) supplies and[MAXstream®](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/plasma-power-products/remote-plasma-sources/maxstream/) 300 plasma source. Advanced Energy will showcase PowerInsight, a platform for data acquisition, monitoring, and analytics.
- Support Power:[NeoPower™](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/design-resources/software/neopower-configurable-software/) series, Evergreen Vento AC-DC enclosed supplies, and iHP air-cooled modular platforms.
- Critical Sensing and Control: 401M pyrometers, M-1200 fiber optic temperature measurement system,[Thyro-XD SCR power controller](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/scr-power-controllers/thyro-family/thyro-xd-power-controller/) and[5540A RF power meter.](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/products/sense-and-measurement/rf-power-sensing/high-power-rf-sensors/5540a-series-rf-power-meters/)


[SEMICON West 2026 | Advanced Energy](https://www.advancedenergy.com/en-us/about/news/events/semicon-west-2026/) | Booth #1539


**About Advanced Energy**


Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement, and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing, and healthcare. With engineering know-how and responsive service and support worldwide, the company builds collaborative partnerships to meet evolving technology requirements, drive customer growth, and innovate the future of power. Advanced Energy has devoted more than four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, USA.
